He is the son of an American former pro basketball player [[Bruce Bolden]], and moved to the United States as a senior in high school. A highly ranked [[college recruit]], he played [[college basketball]] for the [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA Bruins]]. Bolden was ineligible to play with the Bruins in his freshman year in 2014–15 after the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] (NCAA) ruled him a partial-qualifier due to his transferring as a high school senior. After playing with UCLA as a sophomore, he left the school to play professionally. He also played for the [[Australia national under-19 basketball team]] in the [[FIBA Under-19 World Championship]] in 2013. ==Early life== Bolden was born in [[Melbourne, Victoria]], to [[Bruce Bolden]] and Marie Yacoub.
